text.arabic_uthmani: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَٰفِرِينَ

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, asserting the prior asking as completed precedent
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) opens the ayah by certifying the asking as completed history, not as a hypothetical danger. That certified opening turns the compressed report into precedent for the addressees, and it also echoes Surah 5 openings where past communal failure is made present as warning (5:12).

topics.headline: certified past precedent frames the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as an asserted historical precedent, not a speculative caution.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle before a perfect verb as emphatic realization, so the CRITICAL claim about certified past force survives.

topics.headline: Surah 5 past-warning opening returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah changing the live warning of 5:101 into a retrospective communal example, with a same-surah precedent-opening echo (5:12).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah and boundary references; nothing in the guardrails blocks treating the opening as a warning-frame reprise.

words.gloss_range: completed Form I asking with a direct feminine object suffix; locally stronger as demand/request than mere inquiry-about
words.root_gloss_range: asking, requesting, seeking, and demanding; local direct-object grammar selects demand/request while retaining the broader asking field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal or instrumental phrase that carries the same feminine referent into the result

words.prose: {{ar:سَأَلَهَا}} ({{tr:saʾalahā}}) makes the earlier people demand the very referent carried by the suffix, rather than merely ask about a topic. The same suffix links the warning in 5:101 to the later {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}), so the desired object becomes the route into consequence; the perfect third-person form also turns the live second-person prohibition of 5:101 into completed precedent. Its hamza remains the audible pressure point of the verb, with accepted recitation variation affecting the sound-site without changing the direct-object chain.

topics.headline: direct object turns asking into demanded disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the people demanded the referent itself, not merely information about it.
topics.reason: The root allows broad asking/requesting, but the attached direct object licenses the stronger demand-request force while avoiding a claim that every branch of the root is active.

topics.headline: the suffix carries the warned object into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one referent from warning, to demand, to the later causal phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the suffix as the object of the verb and later shows the matching suffix in the causal phrase, supporting the CRITICAL pronoun-chain payoff.

topics.headline: live prohibition becomes third-person completed precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same asking root move from the audience’s possible act in 5:101 to another community’s completed act in 5:102.
topics.reason: The local perfect third-person verb and the explicit 5:101 echo justify preserving the boundary handoff as a structural payoff.

topics.headline: hamza site remains visible under recitation variation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb’s sound pressure is concentrated at the hamza site, while the grammar and object suffix stay fixed.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows can illuminate the sound-site, but they do not replace the canonical local surface or alter the direct-object analysis.

topics.headline: one verb-object unit supplies the cause side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first clause compressing cause into a verb-object unit before the delayed consequence opens.
topics.reason: The attachment parse identifies the first clause and the later sequence clause, so the CRITICAL structural compression survives.

topics.headline: asking is placed inside a wider denial pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this demand as part of a broader asking-before-denial configuration, including the explicit cross-reference to 2:108.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete cross-root and cross-surah evidence, including 2:108, and the local suffix chain keeps the comparison anchored.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative collective noun, singular in form but communal in sense
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, maintaining, and communal body; local noun selects people/community rather than an active standing action
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:qawmun}}) leaves the agent unnamed and indefinite, so the report works as a portable communal warning rather than a story about one labeled group. The singular collective first acts as one body, then reappears through the plural verb of consequence; the standing-community root image remains useful as irony, because a group shaped as a standing body collapses into denial. Same-surah contrasts such as 5:54 show that communal identity can land in opposite outcomes.

topics.headline: unnamed people generalize the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the agent as a generalized communal pattern rather than a narrowly identified group.
topics.reason: The nominative indefinite noun is the explicit subject, and no reference evidence narrows it to a named community.

topics.headline: singular collective becomes plural consequence bearers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same group from one collective actor into plural participants in the resulting state.
topics.reason: The subject attachment and plural agreement on the later verb license the collective-to-plural continuity.

topics.headline: standing root colors communal agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the people as a standing communal body, while the local form still means a people rather than people literally standing.
topics.reason: The q-w-m family supports standing and maintaining imagery, but the local form is a concrete collective noun, so the image is retained without replacing the local sense.

topics.headline: community term enters Surah 5 outcome contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same community word can frame loved communities and failing communities in Surah 5, including the contrast with 5:54.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah references; the local noun is part of that communal-judgment field.

topics.headline: people before you activates prior-community formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the people immediately bound to the before-you frame, turning third-person history into warning distance.
topics.reason: The following prepositional phrase attaches temporally to the clause, and the CRITICAL rows reasonably treat the noun plus phrase as a prior-community formula.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the temporal complement that follows; locally source-in-time, not partitive source from the audience

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later causal or instrumental phrase that carries the means or cause of the result

words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the phrase that pulls the agent into the addressees’ past: the people are from before the audience in time, not a subset drawn from them. The particle therefore assigns origin-in-time to the precedent while leaving the later causal load to {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}).

topics.headline: source particle scopes before-you as time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the phrase as a temporal origin for precedent, not as a partitive people-reading.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following word the governed temporal complement, so broader source or partitive possibilities are narrowed to source-in-time here.

topics.headline: origin and causation are distributed across particles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this particle locates the precedent in time while the later preposition carries the means or cause.
topics.reason: The later causal/instrumental phrase is syntactically attached to the predicate frame, so any causal range of this particle is not the selected local function.

topics.headline: prepositional phrase turns history toward listeners
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the anonymous people repositioned as predecessors of the current audience.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix in the complement and the boundary rows support the CRITICAL claim that the phrase converts report into addressed warning.

topics.headline: formula and nasal binding attach the source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior-community formula and the recited binding of the indefinite people to the time-source phrase.
topics.reason: The formula row and sound row are both anchored in the adjacent noun-plus-preposition phrase and are not contradicted by the grammar.

words.gloss_range: genitive temporal complement with second-person plural suffix, meaning before you in time
words.root_gloss_range: before-ness, facing/fronting, receiving/acceptance; local adverbial form selects temporal precedence while retaining facing/receiving pressure as secondary image

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition governing the temporal before-you complement

words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِكُمْ}} ({{tr:qablikum}}) is the ayah’s explicit hinge back to the addressed audience: the third-person people are before you, not merely before in the abstract. The local grammar selects temporal precedence under {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}), while the root’s facing and receiving field lets that past stand in front of the audience as a failed receiving case. The phrase also joins a wider before-you warning formula, including same-surah precedent language such as 5:5 and 5:75.

topics.headline: suffix anchors history to the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience remains grammatically inside the historical report through the suffix.
topics.reason: The attached second-person plural suffix is local surface evidence, making the audience-specific payoff direct and strong.

topics.headline: before-ness is temporal under the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the phrase as a time marker while not losing the broader root field entirely.
topics.reason: The governed adverbial form selects prior time; acceptance or facing branches remain secondary pressure rather than the local sense.

topics.headline: past confronts the audience as failed reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the past is placed before the audience to be faced, while the word still means before you in time.
topics.reason: The q-b-l family supports facing and acceptance pressure, but local syntax keeps temporal precedence primary.

topics.headline: before-you phrase joins prior-community warning formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this as a familiar prior-community warning shape rather than an isolated date phrase.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah and Quranic formula references, including 5:5 and 5:75, with no guardrail contradiction.

topics.headline: temporal phrase forms the middle beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the temporal phrase as the bridge between cause and consequence, including its compact cadence.
topics.reason: The word order and clause boundary evidence support the CRITICAL claim that this phrase qualifies the agent and buffers the result.

words.gloss_range: sequential conjunction of delayed succession, linking the asking clause to a later consequence
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) is the hinge that connects the demand to the outcome while refusing an instant-result reading. Its delayed succession makes the final state a later development, and the doubled sound gives the tiny conjunction weight at the exact turn from cause to consequence.

topics.headline: then marks delayed consequence rather than immediacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is connected to the asking but develops after an interval rather than arriving as an immediate flash.
topics.reason: The conjunction is parsed as sequence between the two clauses, and the CRITICAL tarakhi payoff is not contradicted.

topics.headline: particle divides cause and consequence scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah split into a cause scene before the particle and a consequence scene after it.
topics.reason: The two-clause attachment parse directly supports the hinge reading.

topics.headline: geminated sound slows the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as weighted in recitation, matching the semantic delay.
topics.reason: The sound claim is tied to the particle surface and reinforces, rather than replaces, the grammatical sequence claim.

topics.headline: delay deepens the historical warning distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah’s retrospective warning stretches consequence across time.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and the local delayed conjunction coherently support this broader warning effect.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect kāna-type verb: they entered/became in a state, with plural subject carried from the collective people
words.root_gloss_range: dawn, morning, brightness, and entering morning; local Form IV copular frame selects become/enter-state while retaining dawn-entry imagery

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative active-participle predicate naming the state entered by the people

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْبَحُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṣbaḥū}}) does not merely report that they denied; it opens a copular state-entry frame that waits for {{ar:كَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:kāfirīna}}) to name the state. The plural ending distributes the consequence across the earlier collective people, while the dawn-family image remains sharply ironic: an entry-into-morning verb leads into a covering-denial predicate. In Surah 5, related becoming scenes such as 5:30, 5:31, 5:52, and 5:53 make this result feel like part of a consequence pattern.

topics.headline: becoming verb requires a predicate state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause presents denial as an entered state, not just a one-time action.
topics.reason: The attachment parse makes the final participle the predicate of this kāna-type verb, confirming the state-entry payoff.

topics.headline: plural verb routes back to the collective people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same unnamed people into plural consequence-bearers without a repeated subject noun.
topics.reason: The implicit plural subject is morphologically present and contextually resolves to the earlier collective subject.

topics.headline: dawn-entry image sharpens the denial state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a dawn or brightness verb introduces a state of covering and denial.
topics.reason: The local predicate selects become/enter-state; dawn and brightness imagery survives as root pressure, not as a separate literal morning scene.

topics.headline: Surah 5 becoming scenes converge on consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this becoming verb joining Surah 5 consequence scenes, including 5:30, 5:31, 5:52, and 5:53.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references, and the local verb’s consequence frame makes the echo relevant.

topics.headline: verb receives the delayed pivot after then
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the delayed conjunction landing specifically in an entered result clause.
topics.reason: The word immediately follows the delayed conjunction and begins the resulting state clause.

topics.headline: state-entry is paired with denial across references
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the rare state-entry plus denial pairing, with supplied cross-references such as 28:82 and 61:14.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows name concrete references and the local predicate directly realizes the pairing.

topics.headline: sound texture carries the dawn root into the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the root texture before the clause lands on denial.
topics.reason: The row is a surface-sound observation anchored to the local word and does not overrule grammar.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine suffix, attached to the predicate frame as the causal/instrumental route into denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final predicate naming the denial state reached through the prepositional phrase

words.prose: {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) is the ayah’s causal loop in one fused word: the suffix reprises the demanded object, while the preposition binds that referent to the becoming-state as means, cause, or accompaniment. Its position before {{ar:كَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:kāfirīna}}) makes the route into denial audible before the denial label itself appears.

topics.headline: preposition marks means and cause, not location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded things become the means or cause through which the people enter denial.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the phrase to the predicate frame and warns against a simple spatial reading; cause and instrument remain jointly live.

topics.headline: the asked object becomes operative cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same suffix from object of desire to factor of ruin.
topics.reason: The repeated feminine suffix is local surface evidence, and the two attachments show the referent changing semantic role.

topics.headline: single fused word compresses relation and referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees connection, referent, and causality carried by one bound form.
topics.reason: The bāʾ relation and suffix fusion are both visible in the surface word and supported by the local predicate attachment.

topics.headline: cause is placed before the denial label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the mechanism inserted between becoming and the final state name.
topics.reason: The phrase sits between the becoming verb and predicate in the local word order.

topics.headline: pronoun keeps warning and report connected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shift from direct warning to third-person report remains tied to the same referent from 5:101.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and local pronoun repetition make the continuity concrete.

words.gloss_range: accusative masculine plural active participle functioning as the predicate of the becoming verb; locally deniers/disbelievers in a settled state
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, disbelief, and ingratitude; local predicate selects denial/disbelief while preserving covering and ingratitude as explanatory pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal or instrumental phrase that brings the demanded referent into the predicate frame

words.prose: {{ar:كَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:kāfirīna}}) completes the clause as an accusative active-participle predicate, so the ayah lands on a settled collective state rather than a momentary denial act. The root’s covering image remains active but narrowed: after the demanded things arrive through {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}), the people cover, deny, or refuse acknowledgment of what came through them. Final position makes this the ayah’s landing point, and same-surah contrasts such as 5:54 and community-denial formulas such as 5:67 keep the communal verdict in view.

topics.headline: active participle is the entered state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial as the state into which the people entered, not merely as a completed action.
topics.reason: The word is parsed as the accusative predicate of the becoming verb, and its active participle form supports ongoing state or identity.

topics.headline: agreement keeps the verdict on the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows the final verdict belongs to the people, not to the feminine suffix referent.
topics.reason: Masculine plural accusative agreement matches the plural subject of the becoming verb and blocks attachment to the feminine pronoun.

topics.headline: predicate states quality rather than titled class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a state-quality predicated of them, not merely a pre-existing titled group label.
topics.reason: The absence of the definite article and the predicate position support the CRITICAL distinction.

topics.headline: covering image explains denial and ingratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees disbelief as covering or refusing acknowledgment after disclosure, while local grammar keeps denial/disbelief as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The k-f-r family supports covering and ingratitude imagery; the local active-participle predicate selects deniers/disbelievers rather than every branch in the family.

topics.headline: covering reverses protective and dawn imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a reversal: after protective covering in 5:101 and dawn-entry language in 5:102, the final word names destructive covering of truth.
topics.reason: The contrast rows are anchored to concrete adjacent and boundary references, but they remain explanatory image-pressure rather than a separate local sense.

topics.headline: final word closes the causal chain with verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close on the moral and epistemic verdict produced through the demanded things.
topics.reason: The final predicate is required to complete the clause, and final position makes the verdict the landing point.

topics.headline: community denial echoes across Surah 5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this ending within Surah 5’s community-outcome contrasts, including 5:54 and 5:67.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and keep the local community-predicate connection anchored.

topics.headline: demand, object-chain, and denial converge at the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as the endpoint of the asking arc rather than a detachable label.
topics.reason: The local chain from the asking verb to the repeated pronoun to the final predicate supports this convergence.

topics.headline: nearby and cross-surah denial echoes continue the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final predicate linking backward to asking-before-denial patterns such as 2:108 and forward to nearby denial language such as 5:103.
topics.reason: The echo rows include concrete references and remain subordinate to the local predicate reading.

topics.headline: consonant texture closes on covering root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word close with the consonantal texture of the covering root.
topics.reason: The sound observation is anchored to the final local word and reinforces the root-image payoff.

topics.headline: reported verdict warns the addressed audience at a distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the current audience warned through another community’s verdict rather than directly named in the verdict.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the third-person subject and the earlier second-person temporal suffix.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same feminine object is carried by سألها and بها, then ثم and أصبحوا mark a resulting state as كافرين.
baseline_models.mechanism: A group asks for or about an object, and its later relation to that very object becomes denial. Asking therefore raises responsibility toward what is obtained, rather than ending when information is supplied.

activation_trace.role: Questioning and requesting supply the initiating demand directed at the pronominal object.
Becoming a state makes denial an acquired outcome rather than a condition already present.
Blocking or denying truth supplies the terminal stance taken toward the requested object.

changed_reading.before: Earlier people asked something and later happened to disbelieve.
changed_reading.after: The demanded object itself becomes the test and locus of their acquired denial; asking increases their liability to the answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قوم من قبلكم and ثم frame a collective event located before the addressees and followed by a delayed change.
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective noun, temporal precedence, and delayed becoming turn one act of asking into a repeatable social trajectory. The warning concerns how a group can consolidate around a stance after disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A human group supplies the collective carrier of both the demand and its aftermath.
Temporal precedence turns the group into a prior case presented to the current audience.
A transition into a condition lets the collective stance congeal after the request.
Denial supplies the group identity produced at the end of the sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies an isolated historical example.
changed_reading.after: The verse models a socially repeatable sequence in which collective requesting eventually hardens into collective denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The request root can foreground a sought object, while ك ف ر can foreground covering a benefit by ingratitude.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the pronominal object is something desired, the sequence runs from seeking a benefit to suppressing its claim to recognition once it is supplied or disclosed.

activation_trace.role: The desired or needed object makes the question a pursuit of something wanted.
Covering a blessing recasts the terminal state as ingratitude toward what was sought.

changed_reading.before: The askers reject a proposition after receiving information.
changed_reading.after: They may also exemplify the paradox of obtaining a sought benefit and then covering its character as a gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first forbids people to prohibit what God has released as lawful, then after the focus denies divine institution of named livestock restrictions and identifies disbelievers as fabricators. The appeal to ancestral sufficiency shows how demanded distinctions can become an inherited normative system that covers divine permission and revelation.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition supplies the unauthorized restrictive act that opens the contextual mechanism.
Release from prohibition supplies the divine permission that human restriction reverses.
The group anchors the focus warning in a community capable of transmitting a normative stance.
Denial anchors the changed reading in the focus outcome.
The repeated denial root explicitly identifies the makers of the false restriction system.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the production process by which unauthorized categories are made.
The contrary of truth marks the fabricated system as falsely attributed rather than merely mistaken.
Claimed sufficiency closes the inherited system against fresh revelation.
Fathers supply the channel through which the restrictive stance is socially inherited.

structural_cues: 5:87 opens the packet by opposing human prohibition to divine permission.
5:103 negates divine authorship of four named animal statuses immediately after the focus and joins disbelief to fabrication.
5:104 answers a call to revelation with ancestral sufficiency, extending focus قوم من قبلكم into lineage-based repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition versus permission, a prior questioning group, fabricated livestock rules, and appeal to fathers. I infer the arrow from insistent demand for distinctions to humanly manufactured restrictions and then inherited closure; a live alternative is that 5:103-104 merely illustrate denial without making questioning part of the production process.

changed_reading.before: The people simply rejected answers to earlier questions.
changed_reading.after: A community can turn demand for rulings into unauthorized categories and then defend them as inherited sufficiency; its كفر institutionally covers revelation with fabricated norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root field that ends the focus in culpable denial earlier names expiation that covers or effaces a bound oath, and that legal sequence ends in gratitude. The contrast opens two responses to speech-created liability: repair the breach, or cover the disclosed truth or benefit.

activation_trace.role: Expiation covers an offense through prescribed repair and supplies the constructive covering trajectory.
Recognition of blessing gives reparative clarification its intended visible outcome.
The focus question anchors the comparison in another utterance that creates consequences.
Denial supplies the destructive covering trajectory selected by the earlier group.

structural_cues: 5:89 distinguishes idle speech from deliberately bound oaths, prescribes concrete repair, and closes with clarified signs so that the audience may give thanks.
5:102 likewise links an utterance to a later accountable state, but no reparative turn appears inside the focus sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ك ف ر derivatives with opposite legal and affective functions, plus gratitude after clarified signs. I infer a contrast between repairing speech-created liability and covering the answer itself; the live alternative is ordinary derivative polysemy with no intended counterpath.

changed_reading.before: كافرين names only a settled identity after questioning.
changed_reading.after: It also marks the wrong direction of covering: instead of effacing liability through repair and displaying gratitude, the group covers the truth or gift disclosed by its own demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's assigned function is conveyance while God knows the manifest and concealed; the next warning says that asking during revelation makes hidden matters appear and may distress the askers. The focus then shows the post-disclosure failure: insistence has converted an optional unknown into an accountable communicated object that is subsequently denied.

activation_trace.role: Delivery of the message sets the authorized channel and limit of communicated material.
Concealment supplies the hidden side of the disclosure boundary before the warning against asking.
Repeated questioning supplies the human pressure that conditions disclosure during revelation.
Repeated emergence into view supplies the direct result of asking about concealed matters.
Distress supplies the adverse reception that can intervene between disclosure and denial.
The same request root carries the disclosure mechanism into the focus precedent.
Denial is the accountable reception that closes the compelled-disclosure sequence.

structural_cues: 5:99 confines the messenger to conveyance and juxtaposes what people manifest and conceal.
5:101 repeats both asking and passive disclosure and conditions the second pair on revelation in progress.
The focus repeats the same feminine object in سألها and بها, preserving the disclosed matter as the later locus or cause of denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conveyance boundary, hidden versus manifest material, asking that produces disclosure and distress, and then asking followed by denial. I infer that insistence increases evidentiary liability by forcing the unknown into disclosure; a live alternative is a narrower warning about burdensome curiosity with no claim that disclosure itself mediates the denial.

changed_reading.before: The verse warns generically that curiosity may precede disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It warns that pressing for disclosure can create the very accountable object one later refuses, so the danger is a self-intensified evidence relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table sequence stages a collective interrogative request for provision and sign, names reassurance, verified truth, and witness as motives, grants descent, and then singles out disbelief afterward. It concretely reenacts the focus movement from demanded object to heightened evidence and possible post-grant denial.

activation_trace.role: The focus request supplies the initiating act whose later analogue is the table petition.
The focus denial supplies the terminal state repeated in the later warning.
A food-bearing table supplies the concrete feminine object requested by the group.
Heart-settling reassurance supplies one stated evidentiary purpose of the request.
Truthful speech supplies the proposition the requested sign is meant to verify.
Causing the object to descend supplies the requested delivery from sign-seeking to grant.
Disbelief after the grant explicitly supplies the same terminal risk as the focus.

structural_cues: 5:112 frames the table request as an interrogative and immediately answers with a warning tied to belief.
5:113 lists eating, heart reassurance, knowledge of truth, and witness as motives, so the request seeks both benefit and evidence.
5:114-115 moves from requested descent to granted descent and then marks disbelief بعد, closely matching the focus sequence of asking, subsequent becoming, and disbelief.
The feminine object pronoun around the descended table in 5:115 echoes focus سألها and بها without establishing that the table is the focus pronoun's referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a group request, concrete provision-sign, reassurance and verification motives, granted descent, and a warning against disbelief afterward. I infer that the later episode deliberately exposes the mechanism compressed in 5:102; the live alternative is a strong intra-packet analogy rather than a direct interpretive referent.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers only a remote precedent with an unspecified requested object.
changed_reading.after: The later table episode makes the precedent operational: a requested gift-sign increases reassurance and evidence, so denial after its grant carries intensified responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant س ء ل to س ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary question branch. It remains anchored in focus سألها and is reinforced by contextual reaching, hiddenness, testing that reveals a state, and forced appearance. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, using language such as 'may evoke drawing out,' never as the lexical gloss of سأل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps the focus root س ء ل to root_000736, whose B001 images gentle or hidden extraction, while the overt anchor remains سألها.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure of the subject produced by contact with an object.
Reaching and attaining supply the grasping motion that activates the extraction image.
Something screened from sight supplies the hidden domain from which material is figuratively drawn.
Repeated emergence into view supplies the endpoint of the figurative extraction.
Gentle or hidden extraction supplies the form-distant material image attached back to the focus act of asking.
Covering supplies the reversal whereby what was drawn out is met by renewed concealment.

changed_reading.before: They verbally asked about an already available object.
changed_reading.after: Their asking may materially evoke drawing concealed matter into reach; that extraction tests and reveals them, and they answer exposure by covering again.

strongest_changes: 5:99-101 turns generic curiosity into a disclosure mechanism: asking during revelation makes hidden matter appear and increases liability to the answer.
5:87 and 5:103-104 connect the focus warning to unauthorized prohibition, fabricated categories, and ancestral closure.
5:112-115 concretely reenacts request, provision-sign, reassurance, grant, and disbelief afterward.
The ك ف ر use for expiation in 5:89 preserves a reparative counterpath to the focus group's destructive covering.
summary.what_was_special: The focus works as a hinge rather than an isolated maxim: its short request-to-denial sequence is prepared by disclosure and legal-boundary material, then unfolded socially in inherited prohibitions and narratively in the table request.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronouns in 5:102 keep the requested object salient but do not independently settle its exact referent.
The table sequence may be a deliberate enactment of the focus mechanism or only a particularly strong analogy within the packet.
The expiation-versus-denial contrast may reflect productive root polysemy without an intended local opposition.
The extraction model depends on a form-distant mapped root and must remain exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Demanded disclosure becomes material for concealment.** `س ء ل B002` is the sought request, `ص ب ح B001` dawn-opening, and `ك ف ر B001` covering. The sequence request–exposure–covering is paradoxical. I infer that curiosity can multiply accountable clarity beyond willingness to bear it, turning gained light into a new object of rejection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The fulfilled request changes the asker’s liability.** Fixed **س ء ل / B002** (“the sought request”) points back to the matters made visible in 5:101. The sequence is request, disclosure implied by the pronoun, then rejection; 5:103 supplies concrete humanly fabricated categories, while 5:104 shows refusal of incoming correction. I infer that once the sought matter is supplied, curiosity becomes an obligation-bearing relation to its answer. Their disbelief reads as the failed second stage of inquiry, not evidence that asking was cognitively empty.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:103–5:104 showed what rejection can become after inquiry: fabricated distinctions harden into an inherited system declared sufficient against correction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiden bilgi edinmek için ona yönelmeyi ve bir şeyi ondan istemeyi aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Doğrudan nesne alan kullanım istek bildirmeye, bir konu ya da kişiyle kurulan ilgeçli kullanımlar ise bilgi edinmeye yönelir; çok soran kişi ve yardım isteyen yoksul için kullanılan adlar bu eylem çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın eylem çekirdeğini korurken, doğrudan bir şeyi isteme ile bir konu veya kişi hakkında bilgi sorma kalıplarını ayrı uygulamalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yönelerek ondan bir şey isteme ya da bir konu, nesne veya kişi hakkında bilgi edinmeye çalışma eylemidir. Doğrudan nesneli istek ve ilgeçli bilgi sorusu bu çekirdeğin farklı kuruluşlarıdır; çok soran veya yardım isteyen kişiye verilen adlar eylemden türeyen kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba yönelip bilgi edinmeye veya bir şeyi elde etmeye çalışma eylemini bildirir.
Bir şeyi doğrudan muhataptan isteme ile bir konu ya da kişi hakkında bilgi sorma, eylemin farklı söz dizimsel kuruluşlarıdır.
Çok soru soran kimse ve gereksinimini bildirerek yardım isteyen yoksul, eylemi yapan kişi olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sorma ve isteme eylemlerini birlikte verir; doğrudan nesneli kullanımda bir şey istenirken, bir konu veya kişi hakkında kurulan kullanımda bilgi aranır. Eylem adı, çok soran kimse ve yardım isteyen kişi de aynı tanıklık kümesinde yer alır.

Kılıcın kınından çekilmesi ve hamurdaki kılın ayıklanması bu işlemin somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi başka bir şeyden çekerek çıkarmadır; anlatım bu işlemin incelikli ve gizli yapılabildiğini de korur.

concept_gloss.text: nazikçe ve fark ettirmeden çekip çıkarma

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları çekip çıkarma ve aradan sıyrılmadan soy ya da özün kökenden çıkmasına, bağlı dizilere, kolay akan suya ve çeşitli somut adlara uzanır. Hastalık, at yarışı, dikiş aracı, kap, ince uzantılar, diş kaybı ve yapı boşluğu gibi bağımsızlaşmış alanlar belirgin çok anlamlılık oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün temel olarak kadınlar dışındaki erkekler topluluğunu anlattığını, kadınların ancak ikincil biçimde kapsama girebildiğini ve insan dışı varlıklara aktarılabildiğini gösterir. Bu nedenle genel ve cinsiyetçe sınırsız bir topluluk adı olarak sunulmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel topluluk anlamını bağlı anlatımlardaki yandaş ve soy çevresi anlamından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Temelde erkeklerden oluşan insan topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaş ve yakın soy çevresini de anlatabilir. Kadınların topluluğa bağlı olarak kapsanması ve sözün insan dışı varlıklara aktarılması ikincildir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderge, kadınlardan ayrı düşünülen erkekler topluluğudur.
Bir erkeğin yandaşları ile yakın soy çevresi, kadınların bağlı olarak kapsanması ve insan dışına aktarım bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği erkekler topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaşları ve yakın soy çevresi bu kapsamda yer alır. Kadınların bağlı biçimde kapsanması ile insan dışı varlıklara aktarım ayrıca kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Erkeklerden oluşan topluluğu ve buna bağlı yandaş ya da soy çevresini birlikte karşılayan en kısa açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek topluluğu çekirdeğini ve bağlı yakın çevre kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınların ikincil kapsanmadığı temel insan topluluğu bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel cinsiyet sınırını ve topluluk anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yönü erkekler topluluğunu çekirdek almasıdır; komşu dal ise topluluğu aşiret, kabile veya ortak iş bağı üzerinden kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sonrakine göre önce gelmesini ve henüz gelmemiş yıl ya da gecenin yaklaşmasını aynı öncelik düzeninde toplar. Gençliğin başlangıcı da bu düzenin yaşam evresine uygulanmasıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından başka bir şeyden önce bulunmasıdır. Yaklaşan yıl ya da gece ile bir yaşam evresinin başlangıcı, bu öncelik çizgisinin ileriye dönük özel kullanımlarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar önce ile sonra arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır ve bu ilişkiyi yaklaşan dönemlere, gelecekteki zamana ve gençliğin ilk evresine uygular.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفارة لما يكفر الخطيئة أو اليمين والتكفير للسيئات والمعاصي حتى تصير كأن لم تعمل
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفارة ما يكفر به من الخطيئة واليمين فيمحى به (ayn)؛ تكفير اليمين فعل ما يجب بالحنث فيها والاسم الكفارة والتكفير في المعاصي (sihah)؛ الكفارة ما يغطي الإثم والتكفير ستره وتغطيته حتى يصير بمنزلة ما لم يعمل (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları fiziksel örtme çekirdeğinden gece ve suyun örtücülüğüne, tohum ile bitki kılıflarına, dinî gerçeği veya nimeti reddetmeye ve günah yükünü gidermeye uzanan radyal bir yapı gösterir; ayrıca uzak yer, dağ geçidi, boyun eğme, taçlandırma ve aynı biçimli bitki-madde adları gibi sözlüksel olarak ayrışmış dallar bulunur.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
